list_databases.label: List Databases
list_databases.description: List the databases shared with your integration, newest edits first.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: How many databases to return, up to 100.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Next-page cursor from a previous run's output.

create_database_item.label: Create Database Item from Field Values
create_database_item.description: Add an item to a database and set its fields.

database_id.label: Database
database_id.description: Only databases shared with your integration are listed.

databaseFields.label: Fields
databaseFields.description: The values to set, by field name, such as {"Name": "Task", "Done": true, "Tags": ["urgent"]}.

content.label: Content
content.description: Plain text added to the item's page body.

update_database_item.label: Update Database Item from Field Values
update_database_item.description: Change field values on an existing database item.

database_id.label: Database
database_id.description: Only databases shared with your integration are listed.

database_item_id.label: Database Item
database_item_id.description: Items in the selected database, listed by title.

databaseFields.label: Fields
databaseFields.description: The values to change, by field name. Empty fields keep their current value. Checkboxes are always saved as given.

notion-find-database-item.label: Find Database Item by Field Values
notion-find-database-item.description: Find items in a database whose fields match exact values.

database_id.label: Database
database_id.description: Only databases shared with your integration are listed.

filterDatabaseFields.label: Fields
filterDatabaseFields.description: Field values the items must match exactly, by field name, such as {"Status": "Done"}.

list_database_pages.label: List Pages
list_database_pages.description: List pages in a database, optionally filtered by field values.

database_id.label: Database
database_id.description: Only databases shared with your integration are listed.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: How many pages to return, up to 100.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Next-page cursor from a previous run's output.

filterDatabaseFields.label: Fields
filterDatabaseFields.description: Field values to filter by, by field name. Empty fields are ignored.

add_comment.label: Add Comment
add_comment.description: Add a comment to a page.

page_id.label: Page
page_id.description: Your 100 most recently edited pages shared with the integration.

comment_text.label: Comment Text
comment_text.description: Posted as a new comment thread on the page.

get_page_comments.label: Get Page Comments
get_page_comments.description: Get all comments on a page, grouped by thread.

page_id.label: Page
page_id.description: Your 100 most recently edited pages shared with the integration.

find_page.label: Find Page
find_page.description: Find pages by title, with exact or partial matching.

title.label: Title
title.description: Full title, or part of it. For example: Meeting notes

exact_match.label: Exact Match
exact_match.description: Only return pages whose title equals the search exactly.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: How many pages to return, up to 100.

notion_create_page.label: Create Page
notion_create_page.description: Creates a new sub-page under an existing Notion page, with a title and optional markdown body.

parent_page_id.label: Parent Page ID
parent_page_id.description: The id of the existing page to create the new page under. Resolve via notion_search.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the new page.

content.label: Content
content.description: Optional body content for the page. Markdown is supported and converted to Notion blocks.

notion_get_page.label: Get Page
notion_get_page.description: Fetches a single page's metadata and property values by id (a database row is a page).

page_id.label: Page ID
page_id.description: The id of the page (or database row) to retrieve. Resolve via notion_search.

notion_archive_page.label: Archive or Restore Page
notion_archive_page.description: Archives (trashes) or restores any page or database row by id via its archived flag.

page_id.label: Page ID
page_id.description: The id of the page (or database row) to archive or restore. Resolve via notion_search.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Set to true to archive (trash) the page, false to restore it.

notion_append_to_page.label: Append Content to Page
notion_append_to_page.description: Appends new block content (parsed from markdown) to the end of a page or block.

block_id.label: Page or Block ID
block_id.description: The id of the page or block to append content to. Resolve via notion_search (page) or notion_get_block_children (block).

content.label: Content
content.description: The content to append. Markdown formatting is supported. Each resulting text block is capped at 2000 characters by Notion.

notion_get_block_children.label: Get Page or Block Content
notion_get_block_children.description: Reads the body content of a page or block by recursively listing its child blocks, optionally rendered as markdown.

block_id.label: Page or Block ID
block_id.description: The id of the page or parent block whose content to read. Resolve via notion_search (page) or this action (child block ids).

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: When enabled, return the content rendered as a markdown string. When disabled, return the raw Notion block JSON tree.

depth.label: Depth
depth.description: Recursively retrieve nested children up to this depth. Only used when Markdown is disabled. Defaults to 1.

notion_update_block.label: Update Block Text
notion_update_block.description: Replaces the text content of a single existing block by id.

block_id.label: Block ID
block_id.description: The id of the block to update. Resolve via notion_get_block_children.

content.label: Content
content.description: The new plain-text content for the block. Split automatically at Notion's 2000-char-per-rich-text-object cap.

block_type.label: Block Type
block_type.description: The type of the block being updated — must match the block's actual type (see its type in notion_get_block_children). Defaults to paragraph.

checked.label: Checked
checked.description: To-do blocks only: tick, untick, or leave the checkbox unchanged.

language.label: Language
language.description: For code blocks only: the programming language (e.g. javascript, python). Ignored for other block types.

notion_delete_block.label: Delete Block
notion_delete_block.description: Deletes (archives) a single block by id, removing it from its page.

block_id.label: Block ID
block_id.description: The id of the block to delete. Resolve via notion_get_block_children.

notion_search.label: Search Pages and Databases
notion_search.description: Searches the workspace by title for pages and/or databases shared with the integration, with exact or partial matching.

query.label: Query
query.description: The title text (or part of it) to search for.

filter_type.label: Type Filter
filter_type.description: Restrict results to pages, databases, or both. Defaults to both (all).

exact_match.label: Exact Match
exact_match.description: When enabled, only return items whose title exactly equals the query. Disable for partial matching.

limit.label: Maximum Results
limit.description: How many items to return at most (between 1 and 100).

notion_list_users.label: List Users
notion_list_users.description: Lists the people and bots in the workspace, returning each user's id, name, and type.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: How many users to return per page (1–100). Defaults to 100.

start_cursor.label: Start Cursor
start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor to fetch the next page.

notion_list_users.afterResponse:
var users = response.results.map((user) => ({ id: user.id, name: user.name, type: user.type, avatar_url: user.avatar_url, email: user.person ? user.person.email : undefined }));
return { users: users, count: users.length, has_more: response.has_more, next_cursor: response.next_cursor };

notion_get_user.label: Get User
notion_get_user.description: Fetches a single workspace user's details by id.

user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: The id of the workspace user to retrieve. Resolve via notion_list_users.

notion_get_user.afterResponse: return { id: response.id, name: response.name, type: response.type, avatar_url: response.avatar_url, email: response.person ? response.person.email : undefined, bot: response.bot };

notion_get_database.label: Get Database Schema
notion_get_database.description: Retrieves a Notion database's schema: its property names, field types, and select/status/relation options.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The id of the database to inspect. Resolve a database title into its id with notion_search (filter_type=database).

notion_query_database.label: Query Database
notion_query_database.description: Queries a Notion database with the API's native filter and sort JSON objects (compound AND/OR, ranges, dates, contains, etc.).

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The id of the database to query. Resolve a database title into its id with notion_search (filter_type=database).

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Optional. A Notion query filter object. A single condition is { "property": "Status", "status": { "equals": "Done" } }; compound is { "and": [ ...conditions ] } or { "or": [ ...conditions ] }. The condition key MUST match the property's type (e.g. status:{equals}, select:{equals}, number:{greater_than}, date:{on_or_after}, rich_text:{contains}, checkbox:{equals}). Run notion_get_database first to confirm property names and types. Omit to list all rows.

sorts.label: Sorts
sorts.description: Optional. An array of Notion sort objects. Sort by a property: [{ "property": "Name", "direction": "ascending" }]; sort by a timestamp: [{ "timestamp": "last_edited_time", "direction": "descending" }]. direction is "ascending" or "descending".

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–100). Defaults to 100.

start_cursor.label: Start Cursor
start_cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor. Pass the next_cursor returned by a previous call to fetch the next page of results.

notion_query_database.afterResponse: return { success: true, results: response.results, count: response.results.length, has_more: response.has_more, next_cursor: response.next_cursor };

notion_create_database.label: Create Database
notion_create_database.description: Creates a new inline Notion database under a parent page, with a title and a property-schema object defining its columns.

parent_page_id.label: Parent Page ID
parent_page_id.description: The id of the PAGE the new database will live under (must be a page, not a database). Resolve it via notion_search.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the new database.

properties.label: Properties (Schema)
properties.description: A Notion property-schema object: a map of column name to a type-config object. Example: { "Name": { "title": {} }, "Status": { "select": { "options": [ { "name": "Open" }, { "name": "Done" } ] } }, "Estimate": { "number": { "format": "number" } } }. EXACTLY ONE property must be of type "title". Common types: title:{}, rich_text:{}, number:{format}, select:{options:[{name,color?}]}, multi_select:{options:[...]}, date:{}, checkbox:{}, url:{}, email:{}, phone_number:{}, people:{}, relation:{database_id}.

notion_update_database_schema.label: Update Database Schema
notion_update_database_schema.description: Updates a Notion database's title and/or column schema (add, rename, retype, or remove properties) by id.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The id of the database whose schema to update. Resolve it via notion_search (filter_type=database).

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional. A new title for the database.

properties.label: Properties (Schema Changes)
properties.description: Optional. A Notion property-schema patch: a map of property name to a type-config object. To ADD or RETYPE a column: { "Priority": { "select": { "options": [ { "name": "High" } ] } } }. To RENAME a column, key by its current name with { "name": "New Name" }. To REMOVE a column, key by its name with the value null (DESTRUCTIVE — drops that column's data). Run notion_get_database first to see current property names and types.

notion_create_database_item.label: Create Database Item from Notion Properties
notion_create_database_item.description: Creates a new row (page) in a Notion database, setting its property values from a raw Notion properties object, with optional body content.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The id of the database to add a row to. Resolve a database title into its id with notion_search (filter_type=database).

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: A Notion properties object: a map of property name to a typed value object matching the database schema. Example: { "Name": { "title": [ { "text": { "content": "My task" } } ] }, "Status": { "status": { "name": "In Progress" } }, "Estimate": { "number": 3 }, "Tags": { "multi_select": [ { "name": "urgent" } ] }, "Due": { "date": { "start": "2026-07-01" } } }. Run notion_get_database first to confirm property names and types.

content.label: Content
content.description: Optional plain-text paragraph to append as the body of the new row (page).

notion_update_database_item.label: Update Database Item from Notion Properties
notion_update_database_item.description: Overwrites property values on an existing Notion database row, identified by its page id, from a raw Notion properties object.

item_id.label: Item ID
item_id.description: The page id of the database row to update. Resolve it via notion_query_database or notion_find_database_item.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: A Notion properties object with the values to set: a map of property name to a typed value object. Only the properties you include are changed; others are left untouched. Example: { "Status": { "status": { "name": "Done" } }, "Estimate": { "number": 5 } }. Run notion_get_database first to confirm property names and types.

notion_find_database_item.label: Find Database Item by Notion Filter
notion_find_database_item.description: Finds rows in a Notion database matching a raw Notion filter object, returning the first match and all matches.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The id of the database to search. Resolve a database title into its id with notion_search (filter_type=database).

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: A Notion query filter object. A single condition is { "property": "Email", "email": { "equals": "a@b.com" } }; compound is { "and": [ ...conditions ] } or { "or": [ ...conditions ] }. The condition key MUST match the property's type (e.g. title:{equals}, rich_text:{contains}, select:{equals}, status:{equals}, number:{equals}, checkbox:{equals}, date:{equals}, multi_select:{contains}). Run notion_get_database first to confirm property names and types.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–100). Defaults to 100.

notion_find_database_item.afterResponse: return { success: response.results.length > 0, results: response.results, count: response.results.length, firstMatch: response.results[0] != null ? response.results[0] : null, has_more: response.has_more, next_cursor: response.next_cursor };

notion_archive_database_item.label: Archive Database Item
notion_archive_database_item.description: Archives (soft-deletes) a Notion database item by its page id, keeping it recoverable.

item_id.label: Item ID
item_id.description: The page id of the database row to archive. Resolve it via notion_query_database or notion_find_database_item.

notion_restore_database_item.label: Restore Database Item
notion_restore_database_item.description: Restores an archived Notion database item back to active status by its page id.

item_id.label: Item ID
item_id.description: The page id of the archived database row to restore. Resolve it via notion_query_database (with an archived filter) or from the response of notion_archive_database_item.
